exposure: Parental Stressor Scale: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (PSS:NICU) Greek version
outcome: Psychometric properties (internal consistency, factorial validity, reliability)
cohort: The study included 150 parents (89 mothers, 61 fathers) of hospitalized neonates from three Greek NICUs.
finding: The Greek version of the PSS:NICU demonstrated strong psychometric properties, supporting the original three-factor structure and showing excellent reliability, with female participants reporting higher stress levels than males.
cross-section timing: During the neonates' hospitalization in the NICU.
